description: Elections commission - Announces that Mr. M.M Rahuman was Declared Elected as a Member of Parliament to Fill the Vacancy created Due to the Determination of the Supreme Count Cancelling the Parliamentary Membership of Mrs. Diana Gamge.
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the filling of a parliamentary vacancy due to a Supreme Court determination that disqualified a sitting Member of Parliament. It details the electoral process for replacing the member, including the notification from the General Secretary of Parliament, the direction to the political party, and the final declaration by the Election Commission. The core subject matter is the electoral process and the declaration of an elected candidate to fill a vacancy, which falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7).
